```{r}
categorised_viral_terms <- viral_terms %>% mutate(category = case_when(
  go_id %in% entry_uncoating ~ "entry_uncoating",
  go_id %in% replication_transcription ~ "replication_transcription",
  go_id %in% assembly_packaging ~ "assembly_packaging",
  go_id %in% egress_envelopment ~ "egress_envelopment",
  go_id %in% immune_evasion ~ "immune_evasion",
  .default = NA
  )
) %>% drop_na(category)

category_seeds <- list(
  entry_uncoating = entry_uncoating,
  replication_transcription = replication_transcription,
  assembly_packaging = assembly_packaging,
  egress_envelopment = egress_envelopment,
  immune_evasion = immune_evasion
)

get_descendants <- function(go_ids) {
  unique(c(
    go_ids,
    unlist(
      lapply(go_ids, function(go_id) {
        GOBPOFFSPRING[[go_id]]
      })
    )
  ))
}

#alternative

categorised_viral_terms <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  category_seeds,
  ~ tibble(
    category = .y,
    go_id = get_descendants(.x)
  )
) %>% drop_na(go_id)
```

```{r}

get_uniprot_go <- function(uniprot_ids) {

  query <- paste0(
    "(", 
    paste0("accession:", uniprot_ids, collapse = " OR "),
    ")"
  )

  url <- "https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search"

  res <- request(url) %>%
    req_url_query(
      query = query,
      format = "tsv",
      fields = "accession,go_id,go_p,go_f"
    ) %>%
    req_perform()

  uniprot_go <- read_tsv(
    resp_body_string(res),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  uniprot_go %>%
    dplyr::select(Entry, `Gene Ontology IDs`) %>%
    dplyr::rename(uniprot_id = Entry) %>%
    separate_rows(`Gene Ontology IDs`, sep = ";") %>%
    dplyr::rename(go_id = `Gene Ontology IDs`) %>%
    mutate(go_id = trimws(go_id))
  }

get_human_go <- function(uniprot_ids) {

  AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys = unique(uniprot_ids),
    keytype = "UNIPROT",
    columns = c("UNIPROT", "GO", "ONTOLOGY")
  ) %>%
    filter(
      ONTOLOGY == "BP",
      !is.na(GO)
    ) %>%
    distinct(UNIPROT, GO) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      uniprot_id = UNIPROT,
      go_id = GO
    )
}


  protein_ids<-intact_corona
  go_annotations<-intact_corona_go
  category_terms<-categorised_viral_terms

categorize_go <- function(protein_ids, go_annotations, category_terms) {

  categories <- go_annotations %>%
    inner_join(
      category_terms %>% dplyr::select(go_id, category),
      by = "go_id"
    ) %>%
    distinct(uniprot_id, category)

  all_ids <- unique(protein_ids)

  ids_with_category   <- unique(categories$uniprot_id)
  ids_with_go_terms   <- unique(go_annotations$uniprot_id)

  ids_uncategorised <- setdiff(intersect(all_ids, ids_with_go_terms), ids_with_category)

  ids_unannotated <- setdiff(all_ids, ids_with_go_terms)

  bind_rows(
    categories %>% filter(uniprot_id %in% all_ids),
    tibble(uniprot_id = ids_uncategorised, category = "uncategorised"),
    tibble(uniprot_id = ids_unannotated,   category = "unannotated")
  ) %>%
    distinct(uniprot_id, category)
}
```

```{r}
all_categories <- bind_rows(
  intact_corona_categories = intact_corona_categories,
  intact_hsv_categories = intact_hsv_categories,
  intact_hiv_categories = intact_hiv_categories,
  hvidb_corona_categories = hvidb_corona_categories,
  hvidb_hsv_categories = hvidb_hsv_categories,
  hvidb_hiv_categories = hvidb_hiv_categories,
  intact_corona_human_categories = intact_corona_human_categories,
  intact_hsv_human_categories = intact_hsv_human_categories,
  intact_hiv_human_categories = intact_hiv_human_categories,
  hvidb_corona_human_categories = hvidb_corona_human_categories,
  hvidb_hsv_human_categories = hvidb_hsv_human_categories,
  hvidb_hiv_human_categories = hvidb_hiv_human_categories,
  .id = "id"
)

all_categories <- all_categories %>%
  tidyr::extract(
    id,
    into = c("dataset", "disease", "organism"),
    regex = "^(intact|hvidb)_(corona|hsv|hiv)(?:_(human))?",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    organism = if_else(str_detect(id, "human"), "Human Seeds", "Viral Seeds")
  )

category_counts <- all_categories %>%
  group_by(
    organism,
    disease,
    dataset,
    category
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_proteins = n_distinct(uniprot_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

category_counts <- category_counts %>%
  mutate(
    dataset = recode(
      dataset,
      hvidb = "HVIDB",
      intact = "IntAct"
    ),
    disease = recode(
      disease,
      corona = "SARS-CoV-2",
      hiv = "HIV-1",
      hsv = "HSV-1"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
category_counts %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = category, y = n_proteins, fill = disease)) +
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_proteins), vjust = -0.4, size = 3.2) +
  facet_nested(disease ~ dataset + organism, scales = "free_y") + 
  theme_bw() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("SARS-CoV-2" = "#F6656A", "HSV-1" = "#31ABE8", "HIV-1" = "#00D100")) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.22))) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 50,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) + 
  labs(y = "Count", x = "Category")
  
ggsave("plots/seed_size/categorised_summary.jpeg", dpi = 300, width = 8.2, height = 6)
```

```{r}
all_categories %>%
  group_by(disease, category, dataset, organism) %>%
  group_walk(function(df, keys) {
    dir_path <- file.path("data/subcategories", keys$disease)
    dir_create(dir_path)
    file_name <- paste(keys$category, keys$dataset, keys$organism, sep = "_")
    write_lines(df$uniprot_id, file.path(dir_path, paste0(file_name, ".txt")))
  })
```

```{r}
base_path     <- "/nfs/home/students/m.patil/ba/data"
subcat_dir    <- file.path(base_path, "subcategories")
human_network <- file.path(base_path, "string_700.tsv")

combos <- all_categories %>%
  distinct(disease, category, dataset, organism)

build_samplesheet <- function(dz) {
  dz_dir <- file.path(subcat_dir, dz)
  cc <- combos %>% filter(disease == dz)

  category_rows <- cc %>%
    mutate(
      seeds = file.path(dz_dir, paste0(category, "_", dataset, "_", organism, ".txt")),
      network = if_else(
        organism == "virus",
        file.path(dz_dir, paste0("ppi_plus_virus_", dataset, ".csv")),
        human_network
      ),
      blacklist = if_else(
        organism == "virus",
        file.path(dz_dir, paste0("virus_seeds_", dataset, ".txt")),
        NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    select(seeds, network, blacklist)

  virus_seed_rows <- cc %>%
    filter(organism == "virus") %>%
    distinct(dataset) %>%
    mutate(
      seeds     = file.path(dz_dir, paste0("virus_seeds_", dataset, ".txt")),
      network   = file.path(dz_dir, paste0("ppi_plus_virus_", dataset, ".csv")),
      blacklist = NA_character_
    ) %>%
    select(seeds, network, blacklist)

  bind_rows(category_rows, virus_seed_rows)
}

diseases <- unique(all_categories$disease)
samplesheets <- set_names(diseases) %>% map(build_samplesheet)

out_dir <- file.path("data/", "input_sheets")

iwalk(samplesheets, function(df, dz) {
  write_csv(df, file.path(out_dir, paste0(dz, "_samplesheet_subcategories.csv")), na = "")
})
```
